component.name: TrayAuth
component.summary: Two-factor codes in your system tray

description.p: TrayAuth keeps your two-factor authentication codes one click away. The tray menu lists every account with its live code - click one and it is on your clipboard, which clears itself twenty seconds later. A panel shows the same codes with countdown rings.

Accounts are added by typing the setup key a site shows next to its QR image, with a live preview of the resulting code before you save. Google Authenticator transfers import directly from QR screenshots, including multi-QR batches. Everything can be exported to plain JSON plus scannable QR images, and the same files restore on the Windows build.
The vault is encrypted with AES-256-GCM, with the key stored in your keyring. TrayAuth makes no network connections of any kind: no account, no sync, no telemetry.

screenshot.caption: Live two-factor codes with countdown rings

description.p: First Linux release: tray menu with live codes, codes panel, Google Authenticator QR import, encrypted vault with keyring-backed key, export and import compatible with the Windows build.
